site.name: Pineshad Mine
overview: Pineshad Mine is a documented historic tungsten property in Boulder County, preserved in federal mineral-exploration records and mapped mineral data.

timeline.text: Federal Defense Minerals Exploration Administration records preserved a tungsten exploration file for the Pineshad property.

moreHistory: USGS Data Series 1004 records the Pineshad Mine under DMEA docket 2312, while federal mineral mapping preserves a closely matching Pine Shade Mine locality near 39.97889, -105.54833. Detailed production and operator chronology have not been confirmed in the retained sources.

sourceReferences.title: USGS Data Series 1004 — Historical Files from Federal Government Mineral Exploration-Assistance Programs, 1950 to 1974
